series.name: Indeks risiko bencana Banjir 2023
series.formula: Published BNPB hazard-specific risk score combining classified hazard, vulnerability/exposure/loss components, and government capacity. H/V baseline IRBI2013 (KRB2011); capacity updated via IKD. Do not equate to overall IRBI or physical hazard intensity.
series.directionExplanation: Higher published score means higher modeled residual risk for this hazard. Natural direction retained.
series.reportingBias: Model/baseline and district capacity-assessment coverage; not event-reporting frequency. District-specific fresh 2023 IKD assessment not established.
series.comparability: Same 2023 publication and hazard construction across named districts, but H/V are historical structural baselines. Different hazards have different score ranges and applicability.
series.redundancy: Hazard-specific component/alternative to overall IRBI, with repeated H/V/capacity structure; additive use beside overall IRBI double counts unless nonredundancy proven.

caveats: Risk is not pure hazard, exposure, realized annual impact, or resilience outcome.

No zero inferred from missing rows; observed numeric zeros would remain zero.
Not directly comparable in level across different hazards.
CV of class-weighted composite points lacks a defensible ratio-scale interpretation.
